deviation: The draft replaces New York law and New York County courts with English law and London courts. England is not Arcadia's chosen forum, and it isn't clearly "neutral" under the fallback, so Arcadia would face unfamiliar law and higher cost to enforce or defend the NDA. Legal approval is required for any non-New York law.
suggested_text: This NDA is governed by the laws of New York. The courts at New York County have exclusive jurisdiction.
